basic_info.description: This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home has been beautifully renovated to offer modern comforts and style. With fresh paint throughout and brand-new laminate flooring, the space feels both inviting and contemporary. The bright and airy living room is the perfect spot to unwind, filled with natural light and enhanced by sleek modern light fixtures. The kitchen, featuring top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet space for all your storage needs. Whether cooking for yourself or entertaining, this kitchen provides everything you need in style and functionality. The updated bathroom offers a shower over tub, combining modern design with convenience. Outside, the large backyard presents endless possibilities for expansion, outdoor living, or gardening. Conveniently located near grocery stores, restaurants, shopping, parks and with easy access to major highways. This home truly offers a blend of indoor comfort and outdoor opportunity. Dont miss out on the chance to make this beautifully renovated property your own!
